question:
Select the correct alternative to fill in the blank with the correct preposition in the following sentence.

The wife has a strange influence ________ her husband.
solution:
The correct answer is '**over**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The preposition "**over**" is used to indicate a dominating or controlling influence in this context.
 
• The sentence describes the wife's influence on her husband, which fits the usage of the word "**over**."
